note: BAC Guatemala's CashBack Restaurantes Visa Clásica: a membership of 247 quetzales a year from the second year (the first free is introductory), refunded on 9,000 quetzals of purchases in the year; its Visa cards in quetzales bear a nominal 51.00% to 64.80% a year (the bank's rates and charges at 31 December 2025), written at the top.
